data.body: Patchset 1 of change 2072 took a Verified -1 on the ubuntu/py3.13 shard. Real failure, not the flake under repair: tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py::test_no_tests_rooted_imports_anywhere_under_tests flagged the NEW oracle file. tests/unit/test_ensures_late_binding_isolation.py:39 imported its same-directory helper as 'from tests.unit import test_ensures_late_binding', a tests.-rooted absolute import. That resolves only when the repository root is on sys.path, which 'python -m pytest' provides (the local verification invocation) but the bare 'pytest' console script used by make test and CI does not -- exactly the masking described in the bug a371 guard's own docstring. Fixed in patchset 2 by importing the helper by bare name ('import test_ensures_late_binding as late_binding'), which pytest's prepend import mode makes resolvable since both files live in tests/unit. Import ordering re-normalised with ruff. Re-verified under the BARE pytest console script: 13 passed, 2 skipped across the isolation oracle, the polluter, test_fsck_ensures and the convention guard; make lint OK, make typecheck OK (625 files). No change to the fix's mechanism -- the _reimportable() context manager and the victim-site identity assertion are untouched. Lesson for this class of change: a new test file must be verified with bare 'pytest', not 'python -m pytest', or a tests.-rooted import passes locally and fails in CI.
